title: DMC3 HD Stage Descriptor and Resource Lifecycle — Wave 2

records.title: Corrected Stage resource cell ABI
records.summary: The minimum runtime StageResourceCell ABI is 0x10 bytes with u16 kind16 at cell +0x00, six semantically unresolved bytes at +0x02..+0x07, and a relocatable 64-bit resource path pointer at cell +0x08. The previously promoted path-at-cell+0 interpretation was shifted by eight bytes.

locations.note: Bank-A row base is file 0x5C30A0 / RVA 0x5C4AA0 / VA 0x1405C4AA0. The old 0x...AA8 address is the first path-pointer field, not the row base. kind16 enum semantics remain unresolved.

records.title: Two Stage descriptor banks expose 189 observed descriptors
records.summary: The executable exposes two StageResourceDescriptor banks: Bank A has 110 descriptors and Bank B has 79, totaling 189 observed descriptor identities. This is a descriptor-universe observation and does not claim 189 independent gameplay stages.

records.title: Numeric Stage ID resolves through selector and group-base indirection
records.summary: Canonical code computes stageId/100 and stageId%100, uses a 10-pointer group-base table and a 193-entry selector space, resolves a Stage resource descriptor, selects a role cell and invokes the resource loader. Exact fallback semantics for invalid or missing IDs remain open.

locations.note: 10-pointer group-base table at VA 0x1405C4A50. Direct resolver code around VA 0x1401B985D/0x1401B9860 performs hundreds/remainder selection.

records.title: Higher-level 363-entry resource lifecycle pool
records.summary: A higher-level resource/load manager at VA 0x140C99D30 contains 363 entries with stride 0x48 partitioned into seven groups [4,136,60,28,1,128,6]. Direct state transitions support 0 free -> 1 loading -> 2 I/O complete/pending postprocess -> 3 ready, with state 4 used for cancellation/teardown before cleanup returns the entry to 0.

locations.note: Runtime pool base VA 0x140C99D30; 363 entries x 0x48. Minimum stable fields include group +0x00, state +0x04, u16 subtype/index +0x08, descriptor pointer +0x18, loaded payload +0x20, owned allocation/container state +0x28.

records.title: Typed post-load normalization occurs before ready state
records.summary: Resources in lifecycle state 2 undergo typed in-place post-load normalization before state 3 ready. Confirmed dispatch includes MOD, EFM, SCM and SHW helpers; PNST recursively dispatches populated members and PAC roots are traversed member-by-member. The observed helpers convert stored relative offsets into in-memory pointers by adding the resource base and writing resolved pointers back in place.
